title: papercusp.json plugin manifest
description: Manifest for a Papercusp plugin. See packages/plugin-sdk for the runtime types.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Standard meta-keyword for editor LSP autocomplete. Operationally ignored by the loader.

name.description: Plugin id. Used as a directory name, Postgres schema prefix, event-bus topic prefix, and capability namespace.

kind.description: Distribution kind. Defaults to 'plugin'. 'pack' = a runtime-less code-tool pack: tools only — no ui/roles/routines/actions, runtime must stay js (tool-distribution-granularity-2026-06-05 D-001/D-004; replaces the never-used 'subagent-pack'). 'template' = a harness/project template (papercusp CLI). 'service'/'theme'/'harness'/'snapshot' = reserved/dormant — the loader treats every non-'pack' value as a default plugin. KEEP IN SYNC with the SDK `kind` union in packages/plugin-sdk/src/index.ts (EI-29).

dependencies.description: Tool/pack/plugin/event deps this unit's tools + reactions need (tool-distribution-granularity D-003 plugin-to-tool deps; events axis: cupboard-public-release-2026-07-12 D-003). Validated at Cupboard install time against the host's pack catalog; same shape as a blueprint's dependencies.

events.description: Event-family deps (D-003). Resolved against provides.events across the pack catalog: an installed provider satisfies it, a Cupboard provider makes it installable, neither is a HARD failure like an unresolvable tool dep — unless optional:true (listen-if-present soft dep).

family.description: The provided event-family id this unit needs.

optional.description: optional:true = listen-if-present soft dep; an unresolvable optional event dep never blocks install.

provides.description: Distribution-unit provisions surfaced to the Cupboard catalog + dependency resolver (cupboard-public-release-2026-07-12 D-003). Mirrors the provides_tools axis at the unit level. Pure DATA — a runtime-less kind:'pack' may declare provides.events (the pack-purity check allows it); actually emitting a family or reacting to one is runtime that rides a plugin.

events.description: Awaitable event-key families this unit provides. Structural subset of the events:catalog EventCatalogEntry; the installed-tier catalog merge lifts these over the builtin registry with provenance.

family.description: Stable family id — the catalog lookup key + buildKey handle. Unique within provides.events.

keyTemplate.description: Exact key template with <param> placeholders; a no-param family is a literal key. Every <name> needs a matching params entry (validated at load).

params.description: Placeholders the keyTemplate interpolates, in order.

name.description: Placeholder name as it appears in the template.

required.description: Must a caller supply it? An omitted optional param collapses its :<name> segment.

describe.description: One line for the catalog + sugar arg docs.
What firing this key MEANS (one line), for the catalog.

triggerPack.description: Pure-data workflow graph (external-triggers D-014/D-015/P-012): N plan|recipe targets, single-target bindings, and event-stitched internal edges. It rides kind:'plugin', never executable-tool kind:'pack'. Installation exposes the graph but never arms it.

inputs.description: Workflow-level declared input JSON Schema. Credential/channel install fields retain their per-field share semantics in configSchema.

defaultStormPolicy.description: Pack-wide storm-policy default; a binding may override it.

targets.description: Graph target nodes. Stored kinds are plan|recipe; a UI tool call is a one-step recipe.

bindings.description: Each binding invokes exactly one target. Chains use internal-source bindings plus edges, never a steps orchestrator.

oneOf.description: Deprecated and rejected by trigger-pack semantic validation: trigger packs do not consume schedules. Use a manual binding and arm the instantiated plan with plans:set-schedule followed by plans:arm-schedule.

edges.description: Internal event edges between bindings. One-node v1 packs declare an empty array.

papercusp.description: Semver range against the runtime version (PAPERCUSP_RUNTIME_VERSION).

protocol.description: Semver range against the plugin wire protocol version. Independent of the runtime release cycle so hooks can evolve without bumping the whole runtime.

capabilities.description: Declarative permissions. Format: namespace:action[:resource]. The host AND-checks declared capabilities against the user-granted set.

actions.description: Action declarations bound at init() time.

ui.description: UI surface contributions. Each entry is a top-level pane/tab a host renders. v1 hosts: React (in-bundle component) and iframe (sandboxed) on desktop; tui-pane in the pui (terminal).

type.description: react = in-bundle component (default for back-compat). iframe = sandboxed iframe (Batch H). tui-pane = a terminal pane the pui opens via zellij, running `command` (revive-plugin-system D-002).

iframeEntry.description: Relative path to the iframe HTML entry. Required when type='iframe'.

iframeNavigateOrigins.description: Origins the iframe is allowed to top-navigate to. Honored by the iframe:navigate cap gate.

command.description: argv to run in the pui's zellij pane. Required when type='tui-pane'. command[0] must be a PATH basename (or absolute path) the plugin holds `compute:exec:<command[0]>` for; runs with cwd = the plugin's install dir. Example: ["sh", "render.sh"].

runtime.description: Optional runtime descriptor. Defaults to {kind:'js'} (existing JS plugins). 'wasm' loads a wasm32-wasip2 component artifact via @papercusp/plugin-loader/wasm. 'daemon' loads a long-running stdio JSON-RPC peer via @papercusp/plugin-loader/daemon.

wasmPath.description: Relative path from manifest dir to the .wasm artifact. Required when kind='wasm'.

daemonCommand.description: argv for the daemon binary. Required when kind='daemon'.

memoryBudgetMb.description: Hard cap for WASM linear-memory growth (MiB). Default 64 (Batch G4).

concurrency.description: Action-invocation concurrency. WASM defaults to 'serial' (mpsc actor pattern); daemon defaults to 'parallel'.

reactions.description: Declarative event-reaction rules (plugin-system-hive-port D-003): when trigger `on` settles, fire one of THIS plugin's tools through normal dispatch. Manifest rules are the declarative subset — `when` is a data-match object, `args` a static object; function forms need an entry-point plugin. Each `on` trigger requires an `events:listen:<on>` capability.

icon.description: Lucide icon name or emoji shown next to the plugin in catalog UI.

bundled.description: Build-pipeline only — DO NOT set in your plugin's manifest. Operator install stamps this on plugins that ship pre-installed; capture excludes bundled plugins from snapshot.plugins[]. Lint rejects author-set values. (rev3 plan G+5 / A10)

snapshot.description: Plugin-author opt-in for files in the per-plugin work-dir that should travel with snapshots. Default: work-dir stripped on capture. (rev3 plan G+4)

path.description: Path relative to plugin work-dir root. Globs supported (minimatch).

redact.description: When 'strip': include path as zero-byte placeholder (vs. absent which means 'never existed').

hidden.description: Hide from catalog surfaces; complements harness_shared.hidden_plugins.

pluginVersionPinned.description: DEPRECATED v1: use `versionPin` instead. Reader still accepts this for back-compat. true → equivalent to `versionPin.mode: 'exact'`; false → equivalent to `versionPin.mode: 'semver'`. Schema previously allowed string here; that's no longer used (was a band-aid for in-flight first-party plugins — replaced by `versionPin` cleanly).

versionPin.description: v2 (rev3 plan G+2) per-plugin version-pinning policy. Replaces `pluginVersionPinned`. mode='semver' for JS plugins (default), 'exact' for legacy strict pinning, 'hash' for content-addressed (WASM/daemon default). allowOverride lets marketplace-flagged security patches supersede pinned versions; defaults to 'security-patch'.

hotReload.description: Hot-reload state preservation opt-in. When `preserveState: true`, the host calls `getStateForReload` before unload and `restoreFromReload(state)` on the next init. State must be JSON-serialisable and ≤ 64 KiB.

kvQuota.description: Optional override of the default ctx.kv quotas. maxBytesPerKey defaults to 10 KiB; maxBytesPerPlugin defaults to 1 MiB.

oauth.description: OAuth provider declarations consumed by ctx.oauth.

main.description: Node-style entry-point hint; CLI also probes index.{cjs,js,mjs,ts}.

config.description: Default config values. configSchema describes the shape; this provides defaults.

_legacyExtras.description: Escape hatch for forward-compatible extras the schema doesn't know yet.

requires.description: Plugin slugs this plugin requires. Used by lock-resolve to build a dependency graph (CLI: papercusp install, papercusp plugin install). Each entry is a slug like "@org/dep-plugin".

recommends.description: Plugin slugs this plugin recommends (soft dependencies — surfaced to the user during install but not auto-installed). Same shape as requires.

defaultConfig.description: Initial config values written to ~/.papercusp/plugin-configs/<slug>.json on first install. Must conform to configSchema if both are declared. Used by papercusp plugin init seeding.
